title: Nirdosha Screen Register v2
description: Inventory and deterministic code-generation contract. Behavioral UI proofs belong in UI-proof-specification.toml.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Consumers use this to select the v2 screen-register rules.

register_id.description: Stable lowercase identifier for this screen register; use it in artifact names and fixture namespaces.

version.description: Human-managed version of the register contents; increment when the inventory contract changes.

source_inventory.description: Repository-relative path or HTTPS URL of the human-maintained inventory from which this register was derived.

source_inventory_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source inventory bytes, allowing consumers to detect source drift.

canonical_order.description: Sorting rule consumers MUST apply before code generation and hashing.

codegen_profile.description: Named generator profile selecting renderer defaults and supported templates.

generator_version.description: Version of the screen generator expected to consume this register.

policy_register_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the policy register used to resolve screen policy and logging policy IDs.

default_timezone.description: IANA timezone used when a screen does not override timezone-sensitive rendering or fixtures.

default_locale.description: BCP-47 locale used for deterministic labels, formatting, and locale-aware fixtures.

id.description: Stable screen identifier used by menus, tests, proof claims, and generated artifact names.

name.description: Human-readable screen name; it is display metadata, not a stable identifier.

module.description: Owning RTM/module namespace used for grouping, ownership, and canonical ordering.

archetype.description: Declared UI archetype or macro family that the generator must instantiate.

items.description: Named archetype option or feature combination consumed by the selected template.
Role and access declaration in the register's role syntax, for example `Analyst:R/W`.
Logical dataset/catalog identifiers read or written by this screen.
Typed blocker reference that prevents promotion of the declared stage.

stage.description: Current implementation stage; consumers use it to decide whether generation, promotion, or blocker reporting is allowed.

file.description: Repository-relative source file containing the implementation or mount for this screen.

notes.description: Human context for maintainers; consumers MUST NOT use notes as executable configuration.

template.description: Template id; must equal the screen's archetype for generated screens.

mount_symbol.description: The `pub fn` the generated serve.nir mounts.

parameters.description: Archetype-specific macro inputs. The generator type-checks the parameter sub-schema per archetype: unknown/missing/typo'd keys are generation errors (see SCREEN_REGISTER_SCHEMA.md).

template.description: Exact generator template key; consumers MUST resolve it rather than infer a template from the screen name.

mount_symbol.description: Exact generated mount function/symbol that connects the screen to its route.

renderer.description: Target renderer(s) for which artifacts and selectors must be generated.

artifact_namespace.description: Stable namespace prefix for generated files, selectors, fixture IDs, and evidence.

items.description: Repository-relative output path that the generator is expected to create or update.

plugin_pack.description: Exact plugin/template pack identifier required by this screen.

items.description: Named generator feature flag; unknown flags MUST fail validation.

route_path.description: HTTP route path the screen mounts on, used for collision detection and OpenAPI generation.

route_owner.description: Module or subsystem that owns route registration and collision resolution.

items.description: Repository glob patterns whose contents are inputs to generation and should be hashed.
Logical domain entity names rendered or mutated by the screen.

store.description: Authoritative store identifier used for reads and writes.

read_model.description: Read-model identifier used to shape deterministic query results.

schema_version.description: Version of the bound data schema; changes require regeneration or an explicit migration.

primary_key.description: Field name used to identify a bound record.

field_mapping_ref.description: Reference to the canonical UI-field-to-entity-field mapping.

catalog_ref.description: Catalog identifier containing authoritative metadata for this binding.

fields.description: Screen fields bound to the entity, in display order.

guard.description: Optional data-plane guard binding; when present, generated reads/writes go through GuardedTable.

name.description: Field name as used by the screen and the generated macro invocation.

type.description: Rust or domain type of the field, e.g. `String`, `i64`, `Option<Email>`.

sensitive.description: Whether the field carries sensitive data that must be masked or redacted.

required.description: Whether the field is required for create/update submissions.

masked.description: Whether the field must be masked in the rendered UI by default.

display.description: Whether the field appears in list/detail views.

editable.description: Whether the field may be edited through the screen.

table.description: Name of the function returning `&'static GuardedTable<_, Entity>` for this screen.

purpose.description: Guard purpose string passed to every `GuardedTable` read/write call.

row_id.description: Fixed row identifier for singleton screens (e.g. settings); omit for keyed entities.

items.description: Stable policy IDs that must resolve before the screen can be generated or certified.

purpose.description: Business purpose explaining why the screen is allowed to access its data.

items.description: Operation the generated screen may request; this is an allow-list, not a UI label.

mask_profile.description: Named redaction/masking profile for sensitive values rendered by the screen.

subject_scope.description: Identity scope applied to records, such as `self`, `team`, `tenant`, or `global`.

segregation_class.description: Separation-of-duties class used to prevent conflicting roles from being combined.

domain.description: Logging domain used to select the applicable logging policy, for example `payments` or `identity`.

country.description: Uppercase ISO-like country scope, `EU`, or `*` for global scope; consumers resolve it against the logging-policy register.

region.description: Optional geographic region within the country scope.

subdomain.description: Optional narrower logging namespace within the domain.

entity.description: Domain entity named in emitted audit/log records.

event_class.description: Controlled event category used for routing, review, and retention.

level.description: Minimum severity emitted by the generated screen instrumentation.

policy_id.description: Logging-policy rule ID that authorizes this domain/country/entity/event combination.

retention_class.description: Retention category resolved by the logging policy, such as a regulated seven-year class.

items.description: Field names that every emitted event must contain.

redaction_profile.description: Named redaction profile applied before an event leaves the UI boundary.

kind.description: Kind of input dependency being pinned.

name.description: Canonical dependency name resolved by the generator.

version.description: Dependency version or revision; omit only when the hash is the sole immutable locator.

owner.description: Team or service accountable for keeping this screen declaration correct.

items.description: Teams or identities required to review changes to this declaration.

change_ticket.description: Issue/change-request identifier explaining why the register entry changed.

last_verified_revision.description: Source-control revision at which the declaration was last checked against implementation.

theme.description: Named design-system theme used by generated renderers.

density.description: Layout density selected for generated controls and tables.

accessibility_level.description: Target WCAG conformance level for generated UI checks.

ordering_key.description: Canonical field sequence used when sorting generated declarations and evidence.

fixture_namespace.description: Stable namespace for generated test data, browser traces, and proof artifacts.

stable_id.description: Optional immutable identifier for this screen across renames and renderer changes.

hash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the exact referenced bytes, formatted as `sha256:<64 hex characters>`.

params_crud_screens.description: crud_screens archetype. Field lists must be subsets of data_binding.fields' non-masked names (masked = the guard forbids submitting them); required-flagged fields must appear in create_fields.

access.description: Vestigial OpenAPI metadata only — never a second enforcement point.

create_fields.description: Write shape for the create form; every entry must be a declared non-masked entity field.

update_fields.description: Write shape for the update form; every entry must be a declared non-masked entity field.

sort_by.description: Declared field the list view sorts by.

countdown_field.description: Declared numeric field rendered as a countdown.

params_dashboard.description: dashboard archetype: widgets[] entries declare { fn, label } over guarded reads; widget fns must return metric-compatible values (i64/f64).

params_kanban.description: kanban_board archetype. column_field must be a declared field (the move handler writes through it); title_field must be declared.

column_field.description: Declared field holding the column marker.

title_field.description: Declared field used as the card title.

move_path.description: POST route for moves; the generator registers it as a literal route.

params_feed.description: communication_feed archetype. refresh_seconds must precede the guard clause in the invocation.

params_settings.description: settings_screen archetype: sections/fields of a JSON-blob-backed settings table; API mounted at /api{route_path}.

params_wizard.description: wizard archetype: steps are literal GET/POST {path}/step/N routes; wizard state rides a dedicated cookie alongside the session.

params_static_embed.description: static_embed archetype: presentational only — no data_binding, no guard requirement, no menu guard reference. The pinned sha256 is verified at macro expansion (content edit without re-pin = build error).

params_report.description: report_builder archetype (RTM 15.2): dimension picker over guarded_aggregate (Aggregate action); counts only; every dimension must be a declared String field of the entity.

params_tree.description: tree_view archetype (RTM 5.6): deterministic parent/child tree over guarded_snapshot; id/parent/label fields must be declared String fields.

params_login.description: login archetype: demo users are seeded by the generated bridge; roles[] here must be role names the register declares.

params_app_shell.description: app_shell_from_toml: no parameters — the shell macro re-reads menus.toml at compile time; the generator validates the register pair instead.
